name: Klavis AI
description: Connects agents to 100+ third-party MCP integrations with managed OAuth, hosted or self-hosted servers, and Strata progressive tool discovery for very large tool sets.

skills.name: Create MCP Instances
skills.description: Spins up hosted MCP server instances for Gmail, Slack, GitHub, and 100+ other services from the Python, TypeScript, or REST API.

skills.name: Handle OAuth Flows
skills.description: Authenticates end users to third-party services with built-in OAuth, and recovers from credential errors via handle_auth_failure.

skills.name: Discover Tools Progressively
skills.description: Routes agents through staged discovery of categories, then actions, then parameters, so thousands of tools fit in the context.

skills.name: Self-Host MCP Servers
skills.description: Runs any Klavis MCP integration locally from prebuilt Docker images, or installs the open-source Strata server with pipx.

skills.name: Run MCP Sandboxes
skills.description: Provisions scalable MCP environments for LLM training and reinforcement learning experiment workloads.
